project_context.domain: Gaming / FiveM Mod Server Landing Page
project_context.goal: Beautify the existing React setup into a stunning, premium gaming landing page without expanding product scope or altering file architecture.
project_context.archetype: 2 (Performance Pro) - Tactical, command-center focus adapted for Elite Gaming/FiveM
project_context.visual_mood: Cinematic, moody, high-octane. Deep Obsidian background with Electric Blaze (Crimson) accents, using technical grid borders.

typography.notes: Bebas Neue is naturally bold and condensed, giving an athletic/gaming impact. Use normal font weight for Bebas Neue since it's already heavy.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing + Bento Grid Protocol (Mode A: Tetris Grid). Visual tension, asymmetry, and technical precision.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-aligned for dense content. Optical alignment over geometric.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.cards: Grid Borders (Technical Look): Expose the skeleton. Container uses border-collapse style with border-border/40 on grid items to create a tactical server UI.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.header: Glassmorphism (Crystal): Sticky nav using backdrop-blur-xl, bg-black/60, and a delicate 1px border-white/10 on the bottom.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.hero_overlay: Max bg-black/50 or bg-gradient-to-r from-black/80 via-black/50 to-transparent. Never completely obscure the background.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Crisp transitions (transition-all duration-300). Buttons should lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and gain a subtle drop-shadow.
motion_and_interaction.marquee: Use a slow, smooth kinetic text marquee ('NO PIXEL • RP • CUSTOM CARS • HEISTS') with text-transparent and stroke styling for an industrial feel.

hero_background.description: Two modified sports cars parked under streetlights at night. Perfect GTA/FiveM vibe.
hero_background.usage: Main hero section background image. Overlay with a dark gradient so left-aligned text is fully readable.

features_background.description: Nighttime Tokyo street view. Tactical, urban vibe.
features_background.usage: Use as a background for a specific 'Server Features' or 'About the City' bento card.

community_image.description: Vibrant car meet at night in an urban parking lot.
community_image.usage: Use in the community/gallery section or as a secondary promotional image.

icons: Use lucide-react for standard icons, ensuring they align with the tactical, clean aesthetic.

implementation_instructions.file_structure: DO NOT alter the overall file structure. Keep App.js, App.css, index.css. Overwrite App.js to become the new single-page FiveM landing page.
implementation_instructions.components: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts to ensure maximum creative freedom. Use Shadcn components only for complex interactions (like dialogs) if needed.
implementation_instructions.testing_attributes: Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, links, and key sections (e.g., data-testid='hero-join-btn').
